|lore=Falleen '''gangster''' and '''leader'''. Black Sun agent. Dark Prince of the Black Sun crime syndicate. Fortifies his personal defenses with information gathered by his agents.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Other Black Sun agents are forfeit +1. Your unique (•) gamblers, gangsters, smugglers, and thieves are Black Sun agents. Once per turn, may take Unexpected Interruption into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Prince Xizor (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Prince Xizor (V) (Virtual Set 7)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #7” (Players Committee; set released 16 July 2004; PDF dated 17 July 2004), page 2, slip 18 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 30 July 2004), linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's home page]: “P 2. Your unique smugglers, gamblers, thieves, gangsters, and information brokers are Black Sun agents. Your Black Sun agents at sites may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Once per turn, may ▲ Unexpected Interruption. Immune to attrition < 2X, where X = the number of Black Sun agents on table.” Stats line: “POWER 5 ABILITY 3 FORCE-ATTUNED”. Deploy 3, forfeit 6. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “7•18” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Prince Xizor (V) (Virtual Set 7) (Errata)]]): the updated sheet of 12 October 2004 (“Updated 10/12/04”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set 7.pdf] on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 5 December 2004; PDF dated 12 October 2004), page 2, slip 18, on the same old slip: “P 2. Your unique (•) smugglers, gamblers, thieves, gangsters, and information brokers are Black Sun agents. Your Black Sun agents at sites may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Once per turn, may ▲ Unexpected Interruption. Immune to attrition < 2X, where X = the number of Black Sun agents on table.” '''What changed:''' “(•)” was added after “2. Your unique”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007], slip 18), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Other Black Sun agents are forfeit +1. Your unique (•) gamblers, gangsters, smugglers, and thieves are Black Sun agents. Once per turn, may take Unexpected Interruption into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
